mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDPC1, indicating strengthening economic demand, boosts consumer and business confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of quarters with positive GDPC1 growth, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5%, signaling a tightening monetary cycle, investors become risk-averse, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 0.3pp increase in UNRATE within 3 months, indicating labor market softening, leads to decreased consumer spending, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 55% of instances with rising UNRATE, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 1.5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When INDPRO and RSAFS both increase, signaling supply chain resilience and strong demand, S&P 500 forward returns are positive over the next 20 trading days due to increased production and consumption.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) during concurrent INDPRO and RSAFS growth.

mechanism_narrative: HOUST exceeding its 6-month moving average, indicating a surge in housing demand, correlates with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to increased economic activity.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of instances when HOUST exceeds its 6-month MA, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 1.5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in CPIAUCSL over 2 consecutive months, signaling easing inflation pressures, leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as interest rates decrease.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 55% of instances with decreasing CPIAUCSL, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2.5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When PAYEMS and UNRATE both decrease, indicating a strong labor market, S&P 500 forward returns are positive over the next 20 trading days due to increased consumer spending and business investment.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) during concurrent PAYEMS and UNRATE decreases.

mechanism_narrative: INDPRO exceeding its 3-month moving average, signaling resilient supply chains, correlates with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to sustained production and economic growth.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of instances when INDPRO exceeds its 3-month MA, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.
